approach: Diagnose via a simulator-seeded both-forms comparison (new SimulatorContextSeed param), generate context variants from the already-built nfcPostureOfInventory per-pair table following the mark-guards.ts idempotent-generator pattern, and route the diagnostic through Layer C as a precomputed ToleranceReport so keyboard-lint never imports the engine. Propose/preview/confirm reuses the existing facet-transform seam; write-back policy is a new field on DiscoveryAxisVector.

decisions.decision: Simulator gains an optional third SimulatorContextSeed parameter (text/caretPos/pendingDeadkeys) rather than a parallel entry point
decisions.why: Smallest change that unblocks every Story 1/2/4 acceptance test; existing callers pass undefined and are byte-for-byte unaffected

decisions.decision: Context-tolerance diagnostic computed engine-side, threaded into keyboard-lint Layer C as a precomputed ToleranceReport input
decisions.why: FR-002 requires simulator-based behavioural comparison, but keyboard-lint is dependency-cruiser-forbidden from importing packages/engine; the existing lintContext.ts pattern already gates checks on precomputed inputs like inventory/touchLayout
decisions.rejected: Relaxing the lint-not-to-engine rule, or moving the whole diagnostic into the unimplemented Layer B style layer

decisions.decision: Reuse nfcPostureOfInventory as-is for the per-pair table; do not consolidate mark-guards.ts buildUnwrap or the blocking-rule generator onto it
decisions.why: Those are shipped, tested spec-071 code with their own blast radius; spec 062 only needs to be a well-behaved fifth caller
decisions.rejected: Consolidating all four/five consumers onto one call site in this feature

decisions.decision: Store-pairing safety reuses analyzeStores/pairSets from applyStoreSlotRemovals.ts before adding decomposed store members
decisions.why: Identical hazard to the one that module already solves (mutating one half of an index()-paired store); reimplementing the pairing graph risks drift
decisions.rejected: A fresh, narrower pairing check scoped only to decomposed-member insertion

decisions.decision: IR mutation follows the mark-guards.ts idempotent-generator pattern (name-prefix markers, ir-insert.ts placement helpers)
decisions.why: Only existing precedent for generating rules/store-members into an IR idempotently without a byte-identical round-trip test to lean on
decisions.rejected: Splicing generated variants into raw .kmn text (forbidden by Constitution Article II)

decisions.decision: Propose/preview/confirm reuses the facet-transform seam (propose.ts/verify.ts, useFacetTransform.ts, FacetTransformPanel output-diff branch); write-back policy stored as a new optional field on DiscoveryAxisVector
decisions.why: output-diff branch already implements FR-008 consequence disclosure; DiscoveryAxisVector is the existing mechanism for a per-keyboard binary author choice, picked up automatically by draftPersistence.ts generic snapshot
decisions.rejected: A new standalone settings bag; a bespoke preview UI

plan.summary: Plan complete: simulator seeding + engine-computed tolerance report threaded into Layer C + facet-transform-seam propose/confirm for context variants
plan.key_finding: keyboard-lint cannot import packages/engine (dependency-cruiser lint-not-to-engine), so the FR-002 simulator comparison must be computed engine-side and threaded into Layer C as precomputed data, not invoked live from keyboard-lint
